segments.an3.142:1.1: “Tayo ca, bhikkhave, bhadre assājānīye desessāmi tayo ca bhadre purisājānīye.
segments.an3.142:1.2: Taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.an3.142:1.3: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
segments.an3.142:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco bhadro assājānīyo … pe … javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
segments.an3.142:2.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo bhadrā assājānīyā.
segments.an3.142:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco bhadro purisājānīyo … pe … javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
segments.an3.142:4.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhadro purisājānīyo … pe … javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca?
segments.an3.142:4.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
segments.an3.142:4.5: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeti, no saṃsādeti.
segments.an3.142:4.9: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhadro purisājānīyo javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
segments.an3.142:4.10: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo bhadrā purisājānīyā”ti.
